answer: A depreciating identity bond blocks sybil hoarding: each identity locks a 500-credit bond that loses 5% per epoch unless refreshed by real work, so parked fakes slide off the ledge of profit. The bond decays every epoch unless a fresh work pulse of real tasks resets it, and the inlet of new rewards opens only to refreshed bonds. An attacker with 1,000 fakes locks 500,000 credits that bleed 25,000 each epoch, while an honest agent holds one bond, does one unit of work, and pays zero net decay.
